newsitem.title: USA: FEI Co says Q3 to fall below expectations.
newsitem.headline: FEI Co says Q3 to fall below expectations.

text.p: FEI Co said Wednesday it expects its third-quarter earnings to fall below analysts' expectations of $0.10 per share.
The company attributed part of the decline to fewer orders than anticipated for its high-end, eight-inch focused ion beam workstations.
FEI said it expects sales for the third quarter ended September 30 would be in the range of $10 million to $11 million.
Company President William Langley said demand for the workstations "will strengthen over the next several quarters."
Its backlog for the product as of September 30 increased to $9.7 million from $6 million at June 30, it said.
